evidence: Tests the BIP32 utility parsing and formatting functions (src/util/bip32) via src/test/bip32_tests.cpp.
rationale: Improves unit test coverage for `ParseHDKeypath()` by verifying parsed vector contents rather than only checking boolean return status. As noted in the description, 'a broken parser implementation returning true while clearing or corrupting the output vector would still pass unit tests', making these assertions and round-trip checks a worthwhile regression shield for BIP32 utility parsing.
